chapter: Solo years, marriages and the Canadian party
title: First wife's death and why that marriage ended
summary: His first wife died of pneumonia while he was hospitalized with the stroke in 1967; they divorced over a house for his mother and her carousing.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: What happened? You mean you changed every 10 years.

No, I just changed when things weren't right. That's all. I don't know what was the hardest. For them to get used to me in my life or me get used to them in their life. That's the hard part. However, the first wife died. Then I got the second wife and the second wife came along in 1945.
How did your first wife die?
From pneumonia, I guess. I was in the hospital when she died.
What were you doing in the hospital?
I was 60 -- I had the stroke in '67 and I was 65.
That's when my first wife died.
Your second wife -- why did your first marriage break up?

Well, because -- I wanted to get a home for my mother and a place that we would have and I wanted to put the home in my mother's name and she didn't want it in my mother's name so I didn't get the home. She wanted it in her name and I didn't want it in her name. And she liked to go and carry on, I guess. Her way of living her way of life and I didn't like that. So I wanted to get a divorce. So I did.
